answer: Nonced Commitment Challenge: each agent hashes a reply to a per-epoch nonce from a public quartz beacon (threshold-ECDSA), committing one epoch early so precomputation is impossible. The anchor rule: any identity that misses its hash deadline is marked dead, outputs frozen. Per-identity opal cost is one hash, one signature per epoch, ~0.0003 BTC gas, multiplied across every sybil node the attacker runs.
